user.title: Connect to tududi
user.description: Create a personal API key in tududi under Profile → API keys. Add one entry per tududi user.

data_description.url: Address of your tududi server, including http:// or https:// and the port if needed. The /api/v1 path must be reachable without a login proxy.
data_description.api_key: Personal API key starting with tt_

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate tududi
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {name} ({url}) no longer works. Enter a new key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the tududi API. Check the URL and that no login proxy blocks /api/v1.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid, expired or revoked.

abort.already_configured: This tududi user is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different tududi user.

data_description.ha_user: The Home Assistant user this tududi account belongs to. The Tududi panel opens this account by default for that user.
data_description.update_interval: How often tududi is polled for changes.
data_description.default_notify: Used for reminders of tasks that are not assigned to a person, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.reminder_tag: Tasks with this tag get daily reminders before their due date.
data_description.reminder_days_before: Start reminding this many days before the due date.

notify.title: Notify targets per person
notify.description: Reminders for tasks assigned to a person are sent to their notify service. Leave empty to use the default notify service.
